Information Systems Group
REFERENCE NO: 202610-0032-SU
DATE October 26, 2026
TO Taxpayers and BIR Users
SYSTEMS AFFECTED ECAR and eONETT Systems
SITE/S AFFECTED All Revenue District Offices (RDOs) and concerned Large Taxpayers
Divisions
REASON In accordance with LRA Circular No. 03-2026 on Nationwide General
System Maintenance, eCAR printing for Real Property transactions will
be temporarily unavailable during the affected period.
PERIOD COVERED
October 27, 2026 (Tuesday)/5:00 PMStart Date / Time
End Date / Time October 30, 2026 (Friday)/11:59 PM
Kindly disseminate this information to all concerned. Thank you.
ISG Management
